say:1:1460702001:1.text: The blooms work! More Sunward Blooms will make the Divine Shard brighter.
say:1:1460702001:1.source_cn: 向阳花果然有用，只要多种一些，神光之石就能保持不灭。

say:2:1460702002:1.text: I found some seeds, Magister Merlin! Shall we plant them?
say:2:1460702002:1.source_cn: 我这里正好有一些种子，梅林大人，我们一起去种下吧。
say:2:1460702002:1.male: I found some seeds, Magister Merlin! Shall we plant them?
say:2:1460702002:1.female: I found some seeds, Magister Merlin! Shall we plant them?
